_about: What households spend each week on one trade's category, by the age of the household reference person (his list of 2026-09-25: customer types). The published averages per household, in the country's currency, from the 'All households' column of each age band's table; `households` the published average weighted number of households a band, in thousands, so a band's share of the category's money is its average times its households over the five. The survey publishes age at the twelve main categories only (ONS, freedom of information response FOI-2024-2222: spending at lower categories by age of household reference person is not published), so hairdressing, one line inside 'Miscellaneous goods & services' with insurance and banking, is not an item here, and 'Restaurants & hotels' holds hotel stays with the meals. United Kingdom: ONS, Family spending in the UK, workbook 2 (financial year ending 2025, released 11 June 2026), Tables A12 to A16, the financial years ending 2023 to 2025 pooled; read 2026-09-26.
